---
title: "Session 5: Migration, Global Mobility and Citizenship"
---

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
### Guiding question
Who belongs to a society, and how do citizenship and border regimes shape access to social rights and participation?
:::

This session looks at migration and global mobility as central dimensions of inclusion and exclusion: belonging, political membership and access to rights and resources.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .session-box}
#### Topics

- International migration and global mobility
- Citizenship and social rights
- Transnational lives and belongings
- Multiculturalism and diversity
- Border regimes and legal exclusion
- Superdiversity
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .session-box}
#### Key theories and concepts

- Transnationalism
- Postnational Citizenship (Yasemin Soysal)
- Superdiversity (Steven Vertovec)
- Border Regimes
:::
